Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray (PA and lateral views) demonstrates a mass in the right upper lung zone, specifically localized to the posterior segment of the right upper lobe on the lateral view. The mass exhibits irregular margins and is associated with prominent hilar/mediastinal opacity suggestive of pathologically enlarged lymph nodes, which are classic radiographic features raising a high suspicion for malignancy (such as lung cancer).
